items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I never will forget this guy's name, the guy's name was Nestor. ... I know Nestor didn't get that money.

ctx.x: The word was out. So that night, we says, 'Okay -- ' Her mother was over to the other big house, you know. When her mother found out what happened, her mother cut her own throat. Now, this is all that's happening. Her mother cut her throat and her dad was just coming in from Denver and when he come in and seen everything that happened, first, he was questioning about the money. He says, 'Who got the money?' He thought it was some Mexican fella got the money. He didn't like this Mexican guy. I never will forget…
